info.title: Zoho Connect Universal API
info.description: Zoho Connect is Zoho's workplace social network and collaboration platform for networks, groups, feeds, tasks, events, and people discovery.

post.description: Creates a new comment in Zoho Connect.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

scopeId.description: ID of the network where the comment should be added.

parentCommentId.description: Reply to an existing comment by supplying its comment ID.

commentContent.description: Comment text. Maximum length is 10000 characters and it supports mentions plus rich formatting.

fileIds.description: Comma-separated file IDs from the upload Files API. Up to 10 files can be attached. Pass multiple values separated by `,`.

post.description: Creates a new task in Zoho Connect.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

boardId.description: ID of the board to add the task to.

dayOfWeek.description: Weekly repeat days. Pass multiple values separated by `,`.

fileIds.description: Comma-separated file IDs to attach to the task. Pass multiple values separated by `,`.

isSelfReminder.description: Whether the task should include a reminder.

monthOfYear.description: Month of the year for yearly recurring tasks.

priority.description: Priority level: None, Low, Medium, or High.

repeatEndDate.description: Day of month when task recurrence should end.

repeatEndMonth.description: Month when task recurrence should end.

repeatEndYear.description: Year when task recurrence should end.

scopeID.description: ID of the network where the task is created.

sectionId.description: Board section to place the task in.

streamId.description: Optional stream ID to link a task to a post.

tagColors.description: Colors for task tags. Pass multiple values separated by `,`.

tagNames.description: Hashtag names associated with the task. Pass multiple values separated by `,`.

userIds.description: Comma-separated user IDs to assign to the task. Pass multiple values separated by `,`.
